name: ai.gateco/gateco
title: Gateco
description: Permission-aware retrieval for AI systems: policy-enforced access to organizational knowledge.

environmentVariables.name: GATECO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Gateco API key WITH THE retrieve SCOPE (Settings > API Keys > Create, tick retrieve). Available on every plan.

environmentVariables.name: GATECO_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Gateco API base URL. Defaults to https://api.gateco.ai; set only for self-hosted or staging deployments.
